value.rationale: The five-adic degeneration of a highly symmetric reflection arrangement makes the entire F5 projective plane the reduced singular locus, and identifies it canonically with a complete conic-secant arrangement. This is a motivated geometric boundary of the H3 invariant quadratic and yields explicit, natural scheme and arithmetic invariants. The plane-point ideal and zeta are consequences supporting the structure, not stand-alone routine claims.
